facts.title: hazard report during commissioning of replacement equipment on HO-9402

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the preparation and approval of a lift study on HO-9402 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on HO-9402 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically directing a lift and controlling the drop zone. HO-9402 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the preparation and approval of a lift study was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 10 January 2011 a hazard report was recorded on HO-9402 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during commissioning of replacement equipment; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
